options.content:
Closed `status` enum of `eero_exporter_api_requests_total`. Sum failures with `status!="success"`.

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `success` | request completed |
| `error` | unclassified API error |
| `auth` | session invalid or expired; re-run `eero-exporter login` |
| `transport` | network / timeout failure reaching the API |
| `rate_limited` | API rate limit hit; collection backs off |
| `validation` | request rejected as invalid (SDK or API 400) |
| `access_denied` | account lacks permission for this resource |
| `not_found` | resource absent (expected for unprovisioned features) |
| `premium_required` | needs an Eero Plus subscription (expected state) |
| `feature_unavailable` | feature not available on this network (expected state) |
